correctness.rationale: PASS. For full A_{n-1} root polytope the support is global maximum minus global minimum; for K_{p,q} it is the larger of two cross-part ranges. A strict loss occurs precisely when the extremal ordered indices share a part, giving [p(p-1)+q(q-1)]/[n(n-1)]. Gaussian coordinate projection to H preserves all root dot products; four independent joint upper/lower Gumbel extremes with log alpha/log beta shifts give the stated nonnegative limiting loss with zero mass 2 alpha beta. The spherical radial factor is handled via chi radius independence and Slutsky; bounded Gaussian extreme moments and E chi_d/sqrt(d)->1 justify mean convergence. Gumbel max-stability plus difference-of-Gumbels logistic integration yield E D=-log(alpha beta)-1. At positive fixed limiting proportions the identical first-order 4 sqrt(2 log n)/sqrt(n) and circumradius sqrt 2 follow. The exact scale factors 2 a_n/sqrt(d) match the support/width convention.
